'''Uviuy Exen''' was a [[Planet|world]]<ref name="SkeletonCrew">{{SkeletonCrew|Very Interesting, As an Astrogation Problem}}</ref> located in the [[Uviuy Exen system]] of the [[Shwuy sector]],<ref name="Appendix" /> a part of the [[Colonies]]<ref name="TFABG" /> and [[the Interior]].<ref name="Interior" /> It was situated in grid square L-9 of the [[Standard Galactic Grid]].<ref name="TFABG" /> The [[super-hyperroute]]<ref name="BMF 48">{{BuildFalconCite|48|Guide to the Galaxy}}</ref> known as the [[Hydian Way]] linked Uviuy Exen to the [[Brentaal system]] in the [[Core Worlds]] as well as to the [[Inner Rim Territories]]' [[Champala system]].<ref name="TFABG" /> In addition, it was connected to [[Palanhi system]] by the [[Shwuy Exchange]] [[hyperspace route]].<ref name="R1" /> Around [[9 ABY]],<ref name="9 ABY">{{SkeletonCrewDate}}</ref> while the [[astronomer]]<ref name="DB Khymm">{{Databank|khymm|Kh'ymm}}</ref> [[Kh'ymm]] was searching her archive of worlds on the [[Observatory Moon]] in order to determine the potential location of the lost planet [[At Attin]], Uviuy Exen's name was listed on her [[computer]] screen among other worlds.<ref name="SkeletonCrew" />

==Behind the scenes==
Uviuy Exen's name was introduced in the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] as a partially cut-off map label in "The History of Neimoidia,"<ref name="BMF 52">{{BuildFalconCite|52|Guide to the Galaxy}}</ref> an article written by [[Mark Newbold]]<ref name="Newbold">{{DMCite|dm=File:MarkNewbold-CreditsBMF.png|creator=Mark Newbold}}</ref> and included in the "[[Guide to the Galaxy]]" department of the [[Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon 52|fifty-second issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon]]'' magazine<ref name="BMF 52" /> that was published around [[December 30]], [[2015]].<ref name="BMF52date">{{BMFdates|52}}</ref> The full name was then featured in [[Star Wars: The Force Awakens Beginner Game|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' Beginner Game]], a [[2016]] [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[roleplaying game]] boxed set.<ref name="TFABG" />

Uviuy Exen was first described as a distinct world in "[[Very Interesting, As an Astrogation Problem]],"<ref name="SkeletonCrew" /> the [[December 10]], [[2024]]<ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|starwars|status/1861409832349172011|''[[Star Wars]]''|date=2024-11-26|quote=Mark your calendars. 🗓️ On December 2, stream the two-episode series premiere of #SkeletonCrew, only on @DisneyPlus.|archiveurl=https://ghostarchive.org/archive/uxgSx|archivefile=File:StarWars-SkeletonCrewSchedule-Twitter.png}}</ref> third episode of the [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]''.<ref name="InterestingEpGuide">{{SW|url=series/skeleton-crew/season-1-episode-3-episode-guide|text="Very Interesting, As an Astrogation Problem" Episode Guide | Star Wars: Skeleton Crew}}</ref> [[Uviuy Exen/Legends|Uviuy Exen]] was originally introduced in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it was first mentioned in the [[1989]] ''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]'', written by [[Greg Gorden]] and published by [[West End Games]] for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Imperial Sourcebook">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref>
